title: Inactivity outreach consumes the cooldown after a rejected email
blast: Members miss the outreach email and become ineligible for retries for seven days; staff see a successful send.

title: Deployment health returns HTTP success for a non-ready deployment
blast: CronExecution records SUCCESS and external HTTP monitoring remains green despite the deploy health result being false.

title: Funding-pending seats are scored as a failure to start training
blast: Unapproved program reservations add a course non-start risk penalty and trigger misleading staff intervention before the member can begin classes.
